independent_morphology_corroboration.source: North Carolina State Extension Plant Toolbox, Hylodesmum nudiflorum
traits: Leafy vegetative stalks and generally leafless flowering stalks are distinct
Leaves comprise three leaflets clustered near leafy shoot's apex
Rose-purple flowers grouped on the largely leafless stalk
Fruits are loments divided into 1–4 segments, bearing hooked hairs
independent_morphology_corroboration.caveat: Extension's structured section labels fruit type 'capsule' but its specific description correctly calls it a legume-derived loment; retain loment, not capsule, for Fabaceae diagnostic data.
